messages.text: I love you more than words can ever say.
Every day with you feels like a beautiful promise of forever.
You are my peace, my joy, and my favorite person in the world.
I want to spend the rest of my life loving and choosing you.
I love you, and I want to be your husband for life.

title: Will you be my wife?
message: My love, you are the woman I want beside me for every dream, every adventure, and every future we build together. I love you and I want forever to start with us.
promises: Love you every day with patience and kindness
Choose you in every season of life
Support your dreams and celebrate your happiness
Build a forever filled with trust, laughter, and love
